title: Restore conventional commit titles and check them in CI
body:
Outcome: every squash commit on main has a conventional title, type(scope): outcome (t-id).
Why: #400 (t-9yrzn7m, 2026-11-08) switched to squash merges with the PR title as the commit subject and wrote 'plain outcome' titles; nothing checked the form, so every commit since #400 lost its type. The operator asked on 2026-11-09 why semantic commits are gone.
Proof: CI fails a pull request whose title is not conventional; the lead skill and lane brief prescribe the form.
Scope: scripts/commit-title.ts, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .agents/skills/krn-lead.
